Five spaces are emitted as segments, with the lab repeating as the first entry because it is the dominant space the others hang off.

notes_for_us: Simulation's typical shapes cannot express a portal hub, and the shape that can is filed under Entertainment. The sharing rule made this reachable, but a genre whose flagship pattern is 'zones you unlock' having no unlock-hub shape of its own looks like a gap in the shortlist rather than in the catalogue.
Time Capsules are a gacha vending stand, and there is no option for one. Egg and capsule stands are near-universal in this family of Roblox game and every one of them will land in free text.

Per-era resource variants - amber, mystical, magic, plasma - are one option ID repeated four times with different words. The dedupe-by-ID rule says present each concept once, but segments makes four entries necessary, and the two rules are not reconciled anywhere.
Nine tenths of this prompt is progression and pets. Routing it all to mechanics was clean and the map that came out is small, which is the triage rule working as advertised.
